results.title: Daiichi Life Insurance Co. Ltd. Makes New Investment in The Progressive Corporation $PGR
results.description: Daiichi Life Insurance Co. Ltd. bought a new stake in shares of The Progressive Corporation (NYSE:PGR – Free Report) in the 2nd quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The fund bought 41,173 shares of the insurance provider’s stock, valued at approximately $8,994,000. A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently modified their holdings of PGR. [...]
